agentSessionKey.title: Agent Session Key
agentSessionKey.description: Stable agent session key if available. Pass automatically from session context.

answersJson.title: Answers JSON
answersJson.description: Final accumulated answers JSON collected during the intake session. Pass from the latest SmartIntake action output.

confirmed.title: Confirmed
confirmed.description: True only after the user has reviewed the collected answers and confirmed they are ready to submit.

consentAccepted.title: Consent Accepted
consentAccepted.description: True if the user accepted required consent before final save. Pass false or leave blank when consent is not required.

intakeSessionId.title: Intake Session Id
intakeSessionId.description: Current SmartIntake session id. Pass from previous action output.

templateKey.title: Template Key
templateKey.description: Metadata template key for the intake form, for example HOTEL_BOOKING_BASIC_V1.
